ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.

2. When practising Phonological Awareness: Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness: Fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness: Fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness: Fluency.

3. When practising Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Conversational Skills.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Conversational Skills.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Conversational Skills.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Conversational Skills.

4. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking.

5. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.

6. When practising Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.

7. When practising Public Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Public Speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Public Speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Public Speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Public Speaking.

8. When practising Reading Aloud: Arabic Alphabet, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud: Arabic Alphabet.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud: Arabic Alphabet.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud: Arabic Alphabet.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud: Arabic Alphabet.

9. In ARABIC LANGUAGE, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud: Fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Reading: Picture Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Reading: Fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
